'''Paul Green''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[December 2000 Pleasanton tournament (second event)]] on 16 December 2000 with [[Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|Raltiir Ops power]] and [[There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him|TIGIH Scouts, Ewoks, and junk]], according to Alfred Dong's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1562">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-19-pleasonton-ca-two-in-one-12-16d1562/ pleasonton-ca-two-in-one-12-16], DeckTech (Alfred "ThaBraHmaBuL" Dong, 19 December 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-19-pleasonton-ca-two-in-one-12-16d1562/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
